{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit sweater, slightly fitted, with a softly scooped neckline and hip length, in warm cream #EFE3D0, merino wool
Midi skirt, A-line with a gentle flare, falling just below the knee, in deep olive #4F5230, fluid crepe
Tailored coat, straight cut with a notched collar, knee length, in camel #B58B5A, wool-blend twill
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, in dark chocolate #3B2A20, soft suede
Small structured shoulder bag in cognac #9A5B32, smooth leather
Small hoop earrings in warm gold #C9A24B, polished metal

This outfit suits a restaurant date: neat and put together without looking overdressed. Cream near the face brightens her warm complexion, while the olive skirt echoes the green in her eyes and sits well beside her brown hair. The skirt's flare gives an easy, feminine movement, and the fitted knit keeps the line balanced. The camel coat adds warmth for an autumn evening, and the suede boots and cognac bag keep the palette cohesive and rich under the soft artificial light of the restaurant."}
